diagnostics.message: The schedule can become active and invoke its target as soon as it is created, but its execution role's inline policy granting lambda:InvokeFunction is created independently. Make the schedule wait for this policy so it cannot fire before the invocation permission is in place.

When this Lambda is configured with VPC networking, its execution role must have the VPC access policy permissions for network-interface operations. The function currently waits for the role itself but can be created before the independently managed VPC execution policy attachment is applied; ensure the attachment is in place before creating/configuring the function.
